item.title: IRGC: Assassination of Mamosta Nezhati shows enemy’s attempt to create division among Muslims
item.description: Urmia, IRNA – The Public Relations Department of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) in West Azarbaijan Province has described the assassination of Sunni Kurdish cleric Mamosta Mohammad Nezhati by Kurdish separatist groups as the enemy’s attempt to create division among Muslims.
item.content:encoded:

Urmia, IRNA – The Public Relations Department of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) in West Azarbaijan Province has described the assassination of Sunni Kurdish cleric Mamosta Mohammad Nezhati by Kurdish separatist groups as the enemy’s attempt to create division among Muslims.

item.title: US sanctions will not stop Iran’s aviation industry: Official

item.title: IRGC official warns of more surprises if US aggression continues
